core_obligations: Preserve exact equality size axioms, epsilon/omega/degree/probability constants and internal parameter regime.
Retain all source-local pseudoexpectation, recursive factorization, structural Hankel, block norm and PSD proof continuations.
Only Theorem1.4 is a target; no technical by-product/support/parameter splitting, no overview substituted for proof.
difficulty_reason: Hard equality constraints require filtration-generated pseudoexpectations, a Hadamard/Euler decomposition and refined graph-ribbon factorization indexed by reduced sizes. The author establishes middle-block positivity through factorial Hankel matrices, then controls structured pseudorandom errors and transfers this to the complete moment matrix. These are visible nonroutine mechanisms across the full proof chain.
